messages.subject: independence assumption
parts:
am studying the factors involved in the reproductive fitness of tree species by a path analysis.
My model involves the effects of two exogenous variables (an ecological variable and tree size) on four endogenous variables (components of reproductive fitness). The structure of the data were obtained from sixty trees (i.e., n= 60 for each exogenous variables), and six data per trees for each endogenous variables (in order to obtain samples of fitness variables I selected six branches per tree) which give me 360 values (60 X 6) per each endogenous variables.

My question is how to perform the analysis using the variables obtained from each branch without violating independence assumption (because all six value from each endogenous variable correspond to the same tree), and how to relate 60 exogenous values (i.e., one per tree) whith 360 endogenous values.

data is clustered (id=tree).

Yves.
